title: TaskInfo
description: A task she started with a tool of the server (web_search, fetch_page), since 1.6. It runs after her reply, or waits until the user approves it.

tool.description: The function that started it (web_search, fetch_page).

toolDescription.description: What the tool does, in a line: a client that keeps a standing approval of the tool writes the tool and this down, so it can show what it approved.

status.description: waiting: for the user's answer (approve or deny). cancelled is also what the user denied.

url.description: The page to read, null for a search.

result.description: What the task found, null until it is done.

error.description: Why it failed, was cancelled or denied, null otherwise.

created.description: When she asked (ISO 8601 date and time).

started.description: When it started running, null before.

steps.description: Its transcript, oldest first; only in the answer for one task, null in the list.
